title: Added the `renderMode` option, which lets a grid, column, or cell skip repainting cells that did not change since their last render, together with the `markCellChanged()` and `markAllCellsChanged()` methods, and made the selection pass update only the cells whose selection state changed. Under `'onChange'`, a vertical scroll paints only the rows that enter the rendered area; with merged cells, the cells of the merged blocks repaint too.
